spots.name: Necedah National Wildlife Refuge
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: World's Fair Wisconsin Pavilion
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Wildcat point
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing west. Good for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Morrisan falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt. About 1 m (3 ft) tall.
